description: Preferred runway modes, owner-supplied 24-10-2026, in priority order (order in this file is the tie-break). 27AD34D's departures are split by SID in real operations (34 via MNG, NONIX and DOSEL; 27 otherwise); the pack has no SID-conditional runway, so both are listed. 34A27AD is LAHSO: 34 active, 27 passive. Its minima (ceiling, visibility, dry surface, no windshear) are not yet enforced — see the enhancement issue. The four single-runway modes are the lowest-priority fallback: 27AD, 16AD and 34AD equal, 09AD the single lowest of every mode. No crosswind limit or capacity has been supplied for any mode; they fall back to the pack default and have no capacity limit.

modes.description: Arrivals 27; departures 34 (via MNG, NONIX, DOSEL) and 27 (all other departures)
LAHSO: arrivals 34 and 27, departures 27. Runway 34 active, 27 passive. Minima not enforced by the engine (see enhancement issue).
